LESSON: ELEMENTS OF MUSIC RESPONDING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING AND
Topic 3.1: Elements of Music RESPONDING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Elements of Music RESPONDING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. listen and identify sounds in the local environment for aural discrimination,
2. respond imaginatively to sounds sounds in the environment in the environment through movement or imitation for enjoyment,
3. identify the character of musical pieces for emotional expression, 318 Property of the Government of Kenya
4. identify the elements of music as used in a song to enhance for effective communication, e) imitate rhythmic and melodic patterns of music to enhance listening skills, music used using music f) respond to music stimuli terminology: loud/ soft imaginatively for self - expression and enjoyment, g) express initial personal reactions to musical performances for effective communication. earners are guided in listening to live/recorded music and imitate the rhythmic and melodic patterns respond to music stimuli imaginatively and creatively opinions about a musical performance and are guided to show respect for the opinions of others.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
